tools.Name: Claude Knowledge Work Plugins
tools.Description: A collection of plugins for Claude Cowork and Claude Code that add role-specific skills, connectors, and slash commands.
tools.Use_Case: Automating specific job functions like sales, product management, and legal analysis by integrating with enterprise tools.

tools.Name: Ouroboros
tools.Description: A local-first Agent OS that treats AI coding as a structured, replayable, and evolutionary specification process.
tools.Use_Case: Turning vague ideas into verified codebases by using a Socratic interview gate and multi-stage automated evaluation loops.

tools.Name: OpenViking
tools.Description: A self-evolving context database for AI agents that organizes memory, RAG knowledge, and skills as a virtual filesystem.
tools.Use_Case: Enabling AI agents to store, search, and recall knowledge across long-term sessions, significantly improving retrieval accuracy.
